INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_vanban_chitiet_new_rt__stg
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(r.StartDate,'%Y') AS yearkey,
        r.ResolutionId,
        r.ResolutionGroupId,
        r.Compendium,
        r.DocCode,
        CASE
            WHEN r.Type = 1  THEN 'Chỉ thị'
            WHEN r.Type = 2  THEN 'Nghị quyết'
            WHEN r.Type = 3  THEN 'Công văn'
            WHEN r.Type = 4  THEN 'Kết luận'
            WHEN r.Type = 5  THEN 'Thông báo'
            WHEN r.Type = 6  THEN 'Đề nghị'
            WHEN r.Type = 7  THEN 'Quyết định'
            WHEN r.Type = 8  THEN 'Báo cáo'
            WHEN r.Type = 9  THEN 'Quy định'
            WHEN r.Type = 10 THEN 'Hợp đồng'
            WHEN r.Type = 11 THEN 'Đăng ký'
            WHEN r.Type = 12 THEN 'Biên bản'
            WHEN r.Type = 13 THEN 'Quy trình'
            WHEN r.Type = 14 THEN 'Hướng dẫn'
            WHEN r.Type = 15 THEN 'Kiến nghị'
            WHEN r.Type = 16 THEN 'Thanh tra'
            WHEN r.Type = 17 THEN 'Tờ trình'
            WHEN r.Type = 18 THEN 'Giấy phép'
            WHEN r.Type = 19 THEN 'Giấy mời'
            WHEN r.Type = 20 THEN 'Danh sách'
            WHEN r.Type = 21 THEN 'Kế hoạch'
            WHEN r.Type = 22 THEN 'Chương trình'
            WHEN r.Type = 23 THEN 'Giấy uỷ quyền'
            WHEN r.Type = 24 THEN 'Đề án'
            WHEN r.Type = 25 THEN 'Thông tư'
            WHEN r.Type = 26 THEN 'Quy chế'
            ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
        END AS Kieu,
        s.SectorName AS LinhVuc,
        DATE_FORMAT(r.StartDate,'%d/%m/%Y') AS NgayVanban,
        r.AssignOrganizationName AS CoQuanBanHanh,
        CASE
            WHEN d.Level  = 2 THEN d.DepartmentName
            WHEN d1.Level = 2 THEN d1.DepartmentName
            WHEN d2.Level = 2 THEN d2.DepartmentName
            WHEN d3.Level = 2 THEN d3.DepartmentName
            WHEN d4.Level = 2 THEN d4.DepartmentName
            ELSE NULL
        END AS loaicapcha,
        CASE
            WHEN d.Level  = 3 THEN d.DepartmentName
            WHEN d1.Level = 3 THEN d1.DepartmentName
            WHEN d2.Level = 3 THEN d2.DepartmentName
            WHEN d3.Level = 3 THEN d3.DepartmentName
            WHEN d4.Level = 3 THEN d4.DepartmentName
            ELSE NULL
        END AS loaicap,
        d.ParentId        AS iddv_captren,
        d.DepartmentId    AS iddv,
        d.DepartmentName  AS donvi,
        IFNULL(d.DepartmentShortName, 'Chưa xác định') AS tenviettat,
        r.CreateUser          AS nguoitao_id,
        u.eGovUserLabel       AS nguoitao_taikhoan,
        u.eGovUserFullname    AS nguoitao_ten,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.TaskId) AS so_nhiem_vu
    FROM
        (SELECT * FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution WHERE DeletedDate IS NULL) r
        LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user u ON r.CreateUser = u.eGovUserId
        LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d ON d.DepartmentIdExt = u.DepartmentPath
        LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d1 ON d1.DepartmentId = d.ParentId
        LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d2 ON d2.DepartmentId = d1.ParentId
        LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d3 ON d3.DepartmentId = d2.ParentId
        LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d4 ON d4.DepartmentId = d3.ParentId
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task WHERE Status <> 5 AND DeletedDate IS NULL) t ON t.ResolutionId = r.ResolutionId
        LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_sector s ON s.SectorId = r.SectorId
    WHERE d.DepartmentId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        r.ResolutionId,
        r.ResolutionGroupId,
        r.Compendium,
        r.DocCode,
        r.Type,
        s.SectorName,
        r.StartDate,
        r.CreateUser,
        u.eGovUserLabel,
        u.eGovUserFullname,
        d.DepartmentId,
        d.DepartmentName
) main
WHERE main.loaicap = 'Văn phòng UBND TP'
;

SELECT
    t.monthkey,
		t.`date`,
    t.`month`,
		t.`year`,
    t.nhomvb_ma,
    t.nhomvb,
    t.ma_nv_cha,
		t.`Code`,
		t.idnv,
		t.tennv_viettat,
    t.Ma,
    t.TenNhiemVu,
    t.SanPhamChuYeu,
    t.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
    t.NgayHoanThanh,
    t.TinhTrang,
    t.TienDoHoanThanh,
		t.tong_so_don_vi_thuc_hien AS tong_so_don_vi_thuc_hien,
    t.songayquahan,
		t.tongtg_canxuly,
		t.tongtg_daxuly,
    -- đơn vị giao = đơn vị hiện tại
    t.don_vi_cap_01     AS don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao,
    t.loaicapcha        AS loaicapcha_dvgiao,
    t.loaicap           AS loaicap_dvgiao,
    t.iddv              AS iddv_dvgiao,
    t.donvi             AS donvi_dvgiao,
    t.tenviettat        AS tenviettat_dvgiao,
    t.NguoiGiaoNhiemVu,

    -- đơn vị thực hiện chưa có
    NULL AS don_vi_cap_01_dvthuchien,
    NULL AS loaicapcha_dvthuchien,
    NULL AS loaicap_dvthuchien,
    NULL AS iddv_dvthuchien,
    t.donvi_dvthuchien,
    NULL AS tenviettat_dvthuchien,
    NULL AS NguoiThucHien,

    t.don_vi_cap_01,
		t.loaicapcha,
    CASE
        WHEN t.iddv IS NULL
            THEN 'Chưa xác định'
        WHEN d1.Level = 3 THEN d1.DepartmentName
        WHEN d2.Level = 3 THEN d2.DepartmentName
        WHEN d3.Level = 3 THEN d3.DepartmentName
        WHEN d4.Level = 3 THEN d4.DepartmentName
        ELSE NULL
    END AS loaicap,
    t.iddv,
    t.donvi,
    t.tenviettat,

    t.DonViPhoiHop,
		t.iddv_dvchutri,
		t.DonViChuTri,
    t.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		t.NgayVanBan,
    t.LinhVuc,
    t.Kieu,
		t.UuTien,
    t.KetQuaGhiChu,
		t.NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
    t.TrangThai,
    REPLACE(t.TrangThaiVietTat,'Chưa HT ','CHT '),
    t.TrangThaiVietTat2,
    t.TenNhiemVu_Mobile,
    'Đã giao' AS NhomGiaoNhan,
    '${sync_ts}'     AS syncdate
FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_nhom_giaonv_new_rt t
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d1
    ON t.iddv = d1.DepartmentId

/* Cha */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d2
    ON d2.DepartmentId = d1.ParentId

/* Ông */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d3
    ON d3.DepartmentId = d2.ParentId

/* Cụ */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d4
    ON d4.DepartmentId = d3.ParentId
-- WHERE t.loaicapcha IS NOT NULL

UNION ALL

INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_new_rt__stg

SELECT
    t.monthkey,
		t.`year`,
		t.don_vi_cap_01,
    t.loaicapcha,
    t.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		t.NgayVanBan,
    t.LinhVuc,
    t.Kieu,
		t.UuTien,

    /* Tổng số nhiệm vụ */
    COUNT(*) AS tongso,

    /* ===== ĐÃ HOÀN THÀNH ===== */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht_dh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht_qh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành không hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht_kh,

    /* ===== CHƯA HOÀN THÀNH ===== */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_th,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_qh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_sqh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành không hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_kh,
		SUM(t.tongtg_canxuly) AS tongtg_canxuly,
		SUM(t.tongtg_daxuly) AS tongtg_daxuly,

    t.nhomvb_ma,
    t.nhomvb,
		t.NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
    t.NhomGiaoNhan,
    NOW() AS syncdate

FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_khoi_new_rt t
WHERE NOT ( t.NhomGiaoNhan = 'Được giao' AND t.loaicapcha = "Thành ủy Hà Nội")
GROUP BY
    t.monthkey,
		t.don_vi_cap_01,
    t.loaicapcha,
    t.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
    t.LinhVuc,
    t.Kieu,
		t.UuTien,
    t.nhomvb_ma,
    t.nhomvb,
		t.NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
    t.NhomGiaoNhan

		
UNION ALL

SELECT
 t.monthkey,
 LEFT(t.monthkey,4) `year`,
 "THÀNH PHỐ HÀ NỘI" AS don_vi_cap_01,
 "Thành ủy Hà Nội" AS loaicapcha,

 t.loai_nhiem_vu_viettat AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
 NULL AS NgayVanBan,
'Chưa xác định' AS LinhVuc,
'Chưa xác định' AS Kieu,
'Chưa xác định' AS UuTien,
SUM( t.tong_so_nhiem_vu) AS tongso,
SUM( t.da_hoan_thanh) AS daht,
SUM( t.da_hoan_thanh_dung_han) AS daht_dh,
SUM( t.da_hoan_thanh_qua_han) AS daht_qh,
0 AS daht_kh,
SUM( t.on_dinh_dung_han) + SUM( t.thuong_xuyen) + SUM( t.dang_tien_hanh_qua_han) AS dangth,
SUM( t.on_dinh_dung_han) + SUM( t.thuong_xuyen) AS dangth_th,
SUM( t.dang_tien_hanh_qua_han) AS dangth_qh,
SUM( t.sap_den_han) AS dangth_sqh,
0 AS dangth_kh,
NULL AS tongtg_canxuly,
NULL AS tongtg_daxuly,
t.nhom_nhiem_vu AS nhomvb_ma,
CONCAT('Nghị quyết ',LEFT(t.nhom_nhiem_vu,2)) AS nhomvb,

 t.monthkey,

SELECT	
    main.monthkey AS monthkey,
    LEFT(CAST(main.monthkey AS CHAR),4) AS `year`,
    main.don_vi_khoi AS loaicapcha,
    main.don_vi_cap AS loaicap,
    main.don_vi_id AS iddv,
    main.don_vi AS donvi,
    main.don_vi AS tenviettat,

    main.can_bo_id AS canbo_id,
    main.can_bo_ho_ten AS canbo_hoten,
    main.can_bo_account AS account,
    main.can_bo_chuc_danh AS can_bo_chuc_danh,
    main.can_bo_chuc_vu AS can_bo_chuc_vu,

    ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) AS diem_danhgia,

    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS diem_chinhtritutuong,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS diem_nanglucvakynang,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS diem_nhiemvu,

    main.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly AS tongso,
		main.nhiem_vu_ton_chuyen_tu_ky_truoc AS ky_truoc_chuyen_sang,
		main.nhiem_vu_den_han_trong_thang AS den_han_trong_thang,
    main.daht AS daht,
    main.daht_dung_han AS daht_dh,
    main.daht_qua_han AS daht_qh,
    0 AS daht_kh,

    main.dangth AS dangth,
    main.dangth_trong_han AS dangth_th,
    main.dangth_qua_han AS dangth_qh,
    0 AS dangth_sqh,
    0 AS dangth_kh,

    main.tyle_hoanthanh,

    -- tháng trước
    main.tongso_thangtruoc,
		main.nhiem_vu_ton_chuyen_tu_ky_truoc_thangtruoc AS ky_truoc_chuyen_sang_thangtruoc,
		main.nhiem_vu_den_han_trong_thangtruoc AS den_han_trong_thang_thangtruoc,
    main.daht_thangtruoc AS daht_thangtruoc,
    main.daht_dh_thangtruoc AS daht_dh_thangtruoc,
    main.daht_qh_thangtruoc AS daht_qh_thangtruoc,
    0 AS daht_kh_thangtruoc,
    main.dangth_thangtruoc AS dangth_thangtruoc,
    main.dangth_th_thangtruoc AS dangth_th_thangtruoc,
    main.dangth_qh_thangtruoc AS dangth_qh_thangtruoc,
    0 AS dangth_sqh_thangtruoc,
    0 AS dangth_kh_thangtruoc,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS tyle_hoanthanh_thangtruoc,

    main.diem_tc01 AS diem_tc01,
    main.diem_tc02 AS diem_tc02,
    main.diem_tc03 AS diem_tc03,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS diem_tc04,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS diem_tc05,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS diem_tc06,

    CASE
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) IS NULL
            THEN 'Chưa có nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) >= 90
            THEN 'Hoàn thành xuất sắc nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) >= 70
            THEN 'Hoàn thành tốt nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) >= 50
            THEN 'Hoàn thành nhiệm vụ'
        ELSE 'Không hoàn thành nhiệm vụ'
    END AS xeploai,

    CASE
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) IS NULL
            THEN 'Chưa đánh giá'
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) >= 90
            THEN 'Loại A'
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) >= 70
            THEN 'Loại B'
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) >= 50
            THEN 'Loại C'
        ELSE 'Loại D'
    END AS xeploai_loaidanhgia,

    NOW() AS syncdate

FROM (
    SELECT
        t.monthkey,
        t.don_vi_khoi,
        t.don_vi_cap,
        t.don_vi_id,
        t.don_vi,
        t.can_bo_id,
        t.can_bo_ho_ten,
        t.can_bo_account,
        t.can_bo_chuc_danh,
        t.can_bo_chuc_vu,

        t.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly,
        t.nhiem_vu_ton_chuyen_tu_ky_truoc,
        t.nhiem_vu_den_han_trong_thang,
        t.daht,
        t.daht_dung_han,
        t.daht_qua_han,
        t.dangth,
        t.dangth_trong_han,
        t.dangth_qua_han,

        ROUND(
            (
                IFNULL(t.daht_dung_han,0)
                + IFNULL(t.daht_qua_han,0)*0.75
            ) / NULLIF(t.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly,0) * 100
        ,2) AS tyle_hoanthanh,

        IFNULL(t_prev.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly,0) AS tongso_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.nhiem_vu_ton_chuyen_tu_ky_truoc,0) AS nhiem_vu_ton_chuyen_tu_ky_truoc_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.nhiem_vu_den_han_trong_thang,0) AS nhiem_vu_den_han_trong_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.daht,0) AS daht_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.daht_dung_han,0) AS daht_dh_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.daht_qua_han,0) AS daht_qh_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.dangth,0) AS dangth_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.dangth_trong_han,0) AS dangth_th_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.dangth_qua_han,0) AS dangth_qh_thangtruoc,

				100 * IFNULL(t.daht / NULLIF(t.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly, 0), 0) AS diem_tc01,
				100 * IFNULL(t.daht / NULLIF(t.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly, 0), 0) AS diem_tc02,

        ROUND(
            (
                IFNULL(t.daht_dung_han,0)
                + IFNULL(t.daht_qua_han,0)*0.75
            ) / NULLIF(t.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly,0) * 100
        ,2) AS diem_tc03

FROM (
    SELECT *
    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_nguoi_xu_ly_new_rt a
    WHERE a.monthkey IN (
        DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m') + 0,
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y%m') + 0
    )
) t

    LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_nguoi_xu_ly_new_rt t_prev
        ON t_prev.can_bo_id = t.can_bo_id
        AND t_prev.monthkey = DATE_FORMAT(
            DATE_SUB(
                STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(t.monthkey,'01'),'%Y%m%d'),
                INTERVAL 1 MONTH
            ),
            '%Y%m'
        ) + 0
) main;

INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_donvi_kiemdem_new_rt__stg
SELECT
    c.monthkey,
		c.`date`,
    c.`month`,
		c.`year`,
		c.don_vi_cap_01,
    c.loaicapcha,

    /* ÉP loaicap = DepartmentName có Level = 3 */
    CASE
        WHEN c.iddv IS NULL
            THEN 'Chưa xác định'
        WHEN d1.Level = 3 THEN d1.DepartmentName
        WHEN d2.Level = 3 THEN d2.DepartmentName
        WHEN d3.Level = 3 THEN d3.DepartmentName
        WHEN d4.Level = 3 THEN d4.DepartmentName
        ELSE NULL
    END AS loaicap,

    c.iddv,
    c.donvi,
    c.tenviettat,
		c.don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao,
		c.loaicapcha_dvgiao,
		c.loaicap_dvgiao,
		c.iddv_dvgiao,
		c.donvi_dvgiao,
		c.tenviettat_dvgiao,
		c.don_vi_cap_01_dvthuchien,
		c.loaicapcha_dvthuchien,
		c.loaicap_dvthuchien,
		c.iddv_dvthuchien,
		c.donvi_dvthuchien,
		c.tenviettat_dvthuchien,
		
		CASE 
			WHEN c.loaicap_dvthuchien IN ( 'Đảng bộ trực thuộc', 'Xã, Phường', 'HĐND Xã, Phường', 'MTTQ Xã, Phường' ) 
				AND ( c.donvi_dvthuchien LIKE '%xã%' OR c.donvi_dvthuchien LIKE '%phường%' )  THEN 'Xã, phường'
			WHEN donvi_dvthuchien IN ('HĐND Thành phố','Thành ủy Hà Nội', 'UBND Thành phố', 'Ủy ban MTTQ Việt Nam thành phố Hà Nội', 'Đảng bộ trực thuộc', 'Xã, Phường', 'HĐND Xã, Phường', 'MTTQ Xã, Phường' )
			OR loaicap_dvthuchien = 'Văn phòng UBND TP' THEN 'Chưa xác định'
			ELSE
				'Sở, ban, ngành'
		END AS donvi_filter,
    c.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		c.NgayVanBan,
    c.LinhVuc,
    c.Kieu,
		c.UuTien,

    COUNT(*) AS tongso,

    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS daht,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND c.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' THEN 1 END) AS daht_dh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND c.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS daht_qh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND c.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS daht_kh,

    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS dangth,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND c.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_th,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND c.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_qh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND c.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_sqh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND c.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_kh,
		SUM(c.tongtg_canxuly) AS tongtg_canxuly,
		SUM(c.tongtg_daxuly) AS tongtg_daxuly,

    c.nhomvb_ma,
    c.nhomvb,
		c.NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
    c.NhomGiaoNhan,
    NOW() AS syncdate
FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_donvi_new_rt c

/* Level hiện tại */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d1
    ON c.iddv = d1.DepartmentId

/* Cha */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d2
    ON d2.DepartmentId = d1.ParentId

/* Ông */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d3
    ON d3.DepartmentId = d2.ParentId

/* Cụ */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d4
    ON d4.DepartmentId = d3.ParentId

WHERE c.iddv IS NOT NULL AND don_vi_cap_01 = 'THÀNH PHỐ HÀ NỘI'
GROUP BY
    c.monthkey,
		LEFT(c.monthkey,4),
		c.don_vi_cap_01,
    c.loaicapcha,
		c.loaicap,
    c.iddv,
    c.donvi,
    c.tenviettat,
		c.don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao,
		c.loaicapcha_dvgiao,
		c.loaicap_dvgiao,
		c.iddv_dvgiao,
		c.donvi_dvgiao,
		c.tenviettat_dvgiao,
		c.don_vi_cap_01_dvthuchien,
		c.loaicapcha_dvthuchien,
		c.loaicap_dvthuchien,
		c.iddv_dvthuchien,
		c.donvi_dvthuchien,
		c.tenviettat_dvthuchien,
    c.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		c.NgayVanBan,
    c.LinhVuc,
    c.Kieu,
		c.UuTien,
    c.nhomvb_ma,
    c.nhomvb,
    c.NhomGiaoNhan,
		c.NhomPhamViNhiemVu
;

(

    canbo_id,

    diem_danhgia,

    diem_nhiemvu,

    tongso,
    daht,

    daht_kh,

    dangth,
    dangth_th,
    dangth_qh,
    dangth_sqh,
    dangth_kh,

    tyle_hoanthanh,

    diem_tc01,
    diem_tc02,
    diem_tc03,
    diem_tc04,
    diem_tc05,
    diem_tc06,

    xeploai,
    xeploai_loaidanhgia
)

SELECT
    main.monthkey,
    main.`year`,
    main.loaicapcha,
    main.loaicap,
    main.iddv,
    main.donvi,
    main.tenviettat,
    main.canbo_id,
    main.canbo_hoten,
    main.account,
		main.canbo_chuc_danh,
		main.canbo_chuc_vu,
		

    main.diem_danhgia,
    main.diem_chinhtritutuong,
    main.diem_nanglucvakynang,
    main.diem_nhiemvu,

    main.tongso,
    main.daht,
    main.daht_dh,
    main.daht_qh,
    main.daht_kh,

    main.dangth,
    main.dangth_th,
    main.dangth_qh,
    main.dangth_sqh,
    main.dangth_kh,

    main.tyle_hoanthanh,

    main.diem_tc01,
    main.diem_tc02,
    main.diem_tc03,
    main.diem_tc04,
    main.diem_tc05,
    main.diem_tc06,

    CASE
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia IS NULL THEN 'Chưa có nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 90 THEN 'Hoàn thành xuất sắc nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 70 THEN 'Hoàn thành tốt nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 50 THEN 'Hoàn thành nhiệm vụ'
        ELSE 'Không hoàn thành nhiệm vụ'
    END AS xeploai,

    CASE
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia IS NULL THEN 'Chưa đánh giá'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 90 THEN 'Loại A'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 70 THEN 'Loại B'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 50 THEN 'Loại C'
        ELSE 'Loại D'
    END AS xeploai_loaidanhgia

FROM
(

SELECT
    m.monthkey,
    LEFT(m.monthkey,4) AS `year`,

    u.loaicapcha,
    u.loaicap,
    u.iddv,
    u.donvi,
    u.tenviettat,

    u.canbo_id,
    u.canbo_hoten,
    u.account,
		u.canbo_chuc_danh,
		u.canbo_chuc_vu,

    /* ===== điểm ===== */

    ROUND(
        (
            SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_dh,0)) +
            SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_qh,0))*0.75
        ) / NULLIF(SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)),0) * 100
    ,2) AS diem_danhgia,

    20 AS diem_chinhtritutuong,
    20 AS diem_nanglucvakynang,

    CASE
        WHEN SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)) = 0 THEN 60
        ELSE ROUND(
            (SUM(IFNULL(t.daht,0)) /
            NULLIF(SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)),0) * 100) * 0.6
        ,2)
    END AS diem_nhiemvu,

    /* ===== thống kê ===== */

    SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)) AS tongso,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.daht,0)) AS daht,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_dh,0)) AS daht_dh,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_qh,0)) AS daht_qh,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_kh,0)) AS daht_kh,

    SUM(IFNULL(t.dangth,0)) AS dangth,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.dangth_th,0)) AS dangth_th,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.dangth_qh,0)) AS dangth_qh,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.dangth_sqh,0)) AS dangth_sqh,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.dangth_kh,0)) AS dangth_kh,

    ROUND(
        SUM(IFNULL(t.daht,0)) /
        NULLIF(SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)),0) * 100
    ,2) AS tyle_hoanthanh,

    NULL AS diem_tc01,
    NULL AS diem_tc02,
    NULL AS diem_tc03,
    NULL AS diem_tc04,
    NULL AS diem_tc05,
    NULL AS diem_tc06

FROM
(
    /* ===== danh sách tháng ===== */
    SELECT DISTINCT monthkey
    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan_new_rt
    WHERE monthkey <= @monthkey
) m

CROSS JOIN
(
    /* ===== danh sách cán bộ từ dm_user ===== */
    SELECT
        canbo_id,
        canbo_hoten,
        account,
        loaicapcha,
        loaicap,
        iddv,
        donvi,
        tenviettat,
				canbo_chuc_danh,
				canbo_chuc_vu
    FROM datamart_hanoi.dm_user
    WHERE loaicapcha = 'HĐND Thành phố'
    AND loaicap <> 'HĐND Xã, Phường'
) u

LEFT JOIN
(
    /* ===== dữ liệu nhiệm vụ ===== */

    SELECT
        t.monthkey,
        t.NguoiThucHienID AS canbo_id,

        COUNT(*) AS tongso,

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_dh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_qh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành không hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_kh,

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_th,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_qh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_sqh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành không hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_kh

    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan_new_rt t

    WHERE t.NguoiThucHienID IS NOT NULL
    AND t.loaicapcha = 'HĐND Thành phố'
    AND t.loaicap <> 'HĐND Xã, Phường'

    GROUP BY
        t.monthkey,
        t.NguoiThucHienID

) t

ON t.canbo_id = u.canbo_id
AND t.monthkey <= m.monthkey

WHERE m.monthkey <= @monthkey

GROUP BY
    m.monthkey,
    u.canbo_id

) main

ORDER BY
    main.monthkey,
    main.canbo_id

SELECT
    t.TaskId AS tt,
    r.DocCode AS so_ky_hieu,
    r.StartDate AS ngay_ban_hanh,
    t.Title AS trich_yeu,

    u.donvi AS phong_tham_muu,
    u.canbo_hoten AS nguoi_soan_thao,
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS nguoi_tao_nhiem_vu,
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS don_vi_nguoi_tao_nhiem_vu,
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS loai_van_ban,

    r.Compendium AS noi_dung_nhiem_vu,
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS linh_vuc,
    tp.TopicName AS chu_de,
    t.isFocus AS nv_quantam,
    rp.nhiem_vu_cho_duyet,

    CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS don_vi_chu_tri,

    t.ExpireDate AS thoi_han,

    CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS tinh_trang,
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS ket_qua_thuc_hien,

    t.UpdatedDate AS ngay_cap_nhat,

    u.canbo_hoten AS dau_moi_cap_nhat,

    u.canbo_chuc_danh AS chuc_danh,
    CASE 
        WHEN t.Priority = 3 THEN 'Hỏa tốc'
        WHEN t.Priority = 2 THEN 'Thượng khẩn'
        WHEN t.Priority = 1 THEN 'Khẩn'
        ELSE 'Thường'
    END AS muc_do_uu_tien,

    NOW() AS syncdate

FROM (
    SELECT *
    FROM datamart_hanoi.dm_user
    WHERE loaicapcha = 'UBND Thành phố'
      AND loaicap IS NULL
      AND canbo_chuc_danh LIKE '%Chủ tịch%'
) u
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT * 
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task 
    WHERE DeletedDate IS NULL 
      AND TargetDepartment NOT IN ('490.698', '490.698.1307', '490.698.1310', '490.698.1841')
) t
    ON u.canbo_id = t.AssignUser
INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution r
    ON t.ResolutionId = r.ResolutionId
LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_topic tp
    ON t.TopicId = tp.TopicId
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT TaskId, 'Chờ duyệt' AS nhiem_vu_cho_duyet
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report
    WHERE Type IN (1, 2, 3, 4)
      AND Status = 0
) rp 
    ON t.TaskId = rp.TaskId;

    CASE

        WHEN d1.Level = 3 THEN d1.DepartmentName
        WHEN d2.Level = 3 THEN d2.DepartmentName
        WHEN d3.Level = 3 THEN d3.DepartmentName

    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' THEN 1 END) AS daht_dh,

INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_tiepnhan_new_rt__stg 
SELECT
main.monthkey AS monthkey,
main.loaicapcha_dvgiao AS loaicapcha_dvgiao,
main.loaicap_dvgiao AS loaicap_dvgiao,
main.iddv_dvgiao AS iddv_dvgiao,
main.donvi_dvgiao AS donvi_dvgiao,
main.tenviettat_dvgiao AS tenviettat_dvgiao,
main.loaicapcha AS loaicapcha,
main.loaicap AS loaicap,
main.iddv AS iddv,
main.donvi AS donvi,
main.tenviettat AS tenviettat,
main.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
main.LinhVuc AS LinhVuc,
main.Kieu AS Kieu,
main.tongso AS tongso,
main.daht AS daht,
main.daht_dh AS daht_dh,
main.daht_qh AS daht_qh,
main.daht_kh AS daht_kh,
main.dangth AS dangth,
main.dangth_th AS dangth_th,
main.dangth_qh AS dangth_qh,
main.dangth_sqh AS dangth_sqh,
main.dangth_kh AS dangth_kh,
main.nhomvb_ma AS nhomvb_ma,
main.nhomvb AS nhomvb,
main.syncdate AS syncdate

FROM (
SELECT 
    DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate,t.ExpireDate,t.CreatedDate), '%Y%m') + 0 AS monthkey,
		CASE
				WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%'  THEN 'Thành ủy Hà Nội'
				WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.1775%' THEN 'HĐND Thành phố'
				WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.1790%' THEN 'Ủy ban MTTQ Việt Nam thành phố Hà Nội'
				WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.698%'  THEN 'UBND Thành phố'
				ELSE 'Khác'
		END AS loaicapcha_dvgiao,
		NULL AS loaicap_dvgiao,
    dv_giao.DepartmentId AS iddv_dvgiao,
    IFNULL(dv_giao.DepartmentName ,'Chưa xác định') AS donvi_dvgiao,
    
		IFNULL(dv_giao.DepartmentShortName ,'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat_dvgiao,
		
		CASE
				WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.695%'  THEN 'Thành ủy Hà Nội'
				WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.1775%' THEN 'HĐND Thành phố'
				WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.1790%' THEN 'Ủy ban MTTQ Việt Nam thành phố Hà Nội'
				WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'  THEN 'UBND Thành phố'
				ELSE 'Khác'
		END AS loaicapcha,
		NULL AS loaicap,
    d.DepartmentId AS iddv,
    IFNULL(d.DepartmentName ,'Chưa xác định') AS donvi,
    
		IFNULL(d.DepartmentShortName ,'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat,
		CASE
        WHEN t.DocCode LIKE "Số %" THEN REPLACE(t.DocCode,"Số ","")
				WHEN t.DocCode IS NOT NULL AND t.DocCode <> "" AND t.DocCode <> " " THEN t.DocCode
        ELSE 'Không xác định'
    END AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		s.SectorName AS LinhVuc,
		CASE
        WHEN r.Type = 1 THEN 'Chỉ thị'
        WHEN r.Type = 2 THEN 'Nghị quyết'
				WHEN r.Type = 3 THEN 'Công văn'
				WHEN r.Type = 4 THEN 'Kết luận'
				WHEN r.Type = 5 THEN 'Thông báo'
        ELSE 'Không xác định'
    END AS Kieu,

    /* Tổng số */
    COUNT(*) AS tongso,

    /* Nhóm đã hoàn thành (Status = 4) */
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)  <= t.ExpireDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_dh,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)  > t.ExpireDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_qh,
		NULL as daht_kh,
    /* Nhóm đang thực hiện (Status in -1,0,1,2,3) */
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND t.ExpireDate >= NOW() AND DATEDIFF(t.ExpireDate, NOW()) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_th,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND t.ExpireDate < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_qh,
		SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND t.ExpireDate >= NOW() AND DATEDIFF(t.ExpireDate, NOW()) <= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_sqh,
		NULL AS dangth_kh,
		
		COALESCE(rg4.ResolutionGroupId,rg3.ResolutionGroupId,rg2.ResolutionGroupId,rg1.ResolutionGroupId,rg.ResolutionGroupId) AS nhomvb_ma,
		COALESCE(rg4.Name,rg3.Name,rg2.Name,rg1.Name,rg.Name)  AS nhomvb,
		NOW() AS syncdate

FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task t
	LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d ON d.DepartmentIdExt = t.TargetDepartment
	LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_giao ON dv_giao.DepartmentIdExt = t.AssignDepartment
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution r ON t.ResolutionId = r.ResolutionId
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_sector s ON s.SectorId = r.SectorId
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg ON r.ResolutionGroupId = rg.ResolutionGroupId -- mức 1: cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg1 ON rg1.ResolutionGroupId = rg.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg1.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 2: cha của cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg2 ON rg2.ResolutionGroupId = rg1.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg2.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 3: cha của cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg3 ON rg3.ResolutionGroupId = rg2.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg3.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 4: cha của cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg4 ON rg4.ResolutionGroupId = rg3.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg4.IsRoot = 0
WHERE
    t.Status <> 5
    AND t.DeletedDate IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate,t.ExpireDate,t.CreatedDate), '%Y%m'),
		t.AssignDepartment,
    t.TargetDepartment,
		t.DocCode
		) main
ORDER BY 
    monthkey,
    iddv;
/* đổi chỗ nguyên tử, chờ khóa tối đa 10s */
SET SESSION lock_wait_timeout = 10;
RENAME TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_tiepnhan_new_rt TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_tiepnhan_new_rt__old, datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_tiepnhan_new_rt__stg TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_tiepnhan_new_rt, datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_tiepnhan_new_rt__old TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_tiepnhan_new_rt__stg;

						WHEN t.AssignDepartment IS NULL OR t.AssignDepartment = 'Chưa xác định'
								THEN 'Chưa xác định'
						WHEN  dv_giao.Level = 3 THEN dv_giao.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao1.Level = 3 THEN dv_giao1.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao2.Level = 3 THEN dv_giao2.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao3.Level = 3 THEN dv_giao3.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao4.Level = 3 THEN dv_giao4.DepartmentName
						ELSE NULL
				END AS CHAR(255)) AS loaicap_dvgiao,
				dv_giao.DepartmentId AS iddv_dvgiao,
				IFNULL(dv_giao.DepartmentName, 'Chưa xác định') AS donvi_dvgiao,
				IFNULL(dv_giao.DepartmentShortName, 'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat_dvgiao,
				dv_giao.ParentId AS iddv_captren_dvgiao,
				t.AssignUser AS NguoiGiaoNhiemVuID,
				IFNULL(u_giao.FullName, 'Chưa xác định') AS NguoiGiaoNhiemVu,
				
				CASE
						WHEN t.TargetDepartment IS NULL OR t.TargetDepartment = 'Chưa xác định'
								THEN 'Chưa xác định'
						WHEN  d.Level = 1 THEN d.DepartmentName
						WHEN d1.Level = 1 THEN d1.DepartmentName
						WHEN d2.Level = 1 THEN d2.DepartmentName
						WHEN d3.Level = 1 THEN d3.DepartmentName
						WHEN d4.Level = 1 THEN d4.DepartmentName
						ELSE NULL
				END AS don_vi_cap_01,
				
				CASE
						WHEN t.TargetDepartment IS NULL OR t.TargetDepartment = 'Chưa xác định'
								THEN 'Chưa xác định'
						WHEN  d.Level = 2 THEN d.DepartmentName
						WHEN d1.Level = 2 THEN d1.DepartmentName
						WHEN d2.Level = 2 THEN d2.DepartmentName
						WHEN d3.Level = 2 THEN d3.DepartmentName
						WHEN d4.Level = 2 THEN d4.DepartmentName
						ELSE NULL
				END AS loaicapcha,
				CASE
						WHEN t.TargetDepartment IS NULL OR t.TargetDepartment = 'Chưa xác định'
								THEN 'Chưa xác định'
						WHEN  d.Level = 3 THEN d.DepartmentName
						WHEN d1.Level = 3 THEN d1.DepartmentName
						WHEN d2.Level = 3 THEN d2.DepartmentName
						WHEN d3.Level = 3 THEN d3.DepartmentName
						WHEN d4.Level = 3 THEN d4.DepartmentName
						ELSE NULL
				END AS loaicap,
				d.DepartmentId AS iddv,
				IFNULL(d.DepartmentName ,'Chưa xác định') AS donvi,
				IFNULL(d.DepartmentShortName ,'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat,
				d.ParentId AS iddv_captren,
				t.TargetUser AS NguoiThucHienID,
				IFNULL(u_thuchien.FullName, 'Chưa xác định') AS NguoiThucHien,
        NULL AS DonViPhoiHop,
				NULL AS iddv_dvchutri,
				NULL AS DonViChuTri,
				/* Bên tạo nhiệm vụ */
				IFNULL(u_taonv.don_vi_cap_01, 'Chưa xác định') AS don_vi_cap_01_dvtaonv,
				IFNULL(u_taonv.loaicapcha, 'Chưa xác định') AS loaicapcha_dvtaonv,
				IFNULL(u_taonv.loaicap, 'Chưa xác định') AS loaicap_dvtaonv,
				u_taonv.iddv AS iddv_dvtaonv,
				IFNULL(u_taonv.donvi, 'Chưa xác định') AS donvi_dvtaonv,
				IFNULL(u_taonv.tenviettat, 'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat_dvtaonv,
				u_taonv.iddv_captren AS iddv_captren_dvtaonv,
				t.CreateUser AS NguoiTaoNhiemVuID,
				IFNULL(u_taonv.canbo_hoten, 'Chưa xác định') AS NguoiTaoNhiemVu,

        /* 12 - Văn bản giao */
        CASE
            WHEN t.DocCode LIKE "Số %" THEN REPLACE(t.DocCode ,"Số ", "")
						WHEN t.DocCode IS NOT NULL AND t.DocCode <> "" AND t.DocCode <> " " THEN t.DocCode
            ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
        END AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
				r.StartDate AS NgayVanBan,
				IFNULL(s.SectorName, 'Chưa xác định') AS LinhVuc,

        /* 13 - Ghi chú */
        NULL AS KetQuaGhiChu,

        /* 14 - Trạng thái chi tiết */
        CASE
						WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) AND DATE( COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) )  <= DATE(t.ExpireDate)
								THEN 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn'
						WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) AND DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) )  > DATE(t.ExpireDate)
								THEN 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn'
						WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= DATE( NOW() ) AND DATEDIFF(t.ExpireDate, NOW() ) > 5 
								THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'
						WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < DATE( NOW() )
								THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
						WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= DATE( NOW() ) AND DATEDIFF(t.ExpireDate, NOW() ) <= 5 
								THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn'
						ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
				END AS TrangThai,
				
				CASE
						WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) THEN
								DATEDIFF(
										COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate),
										t.CreatedDate
								)
						ELSE NULL
				END AS tongtg_daxuly,
				DATEDIFF(
						t.ExpireDate,
						t.CreatedDate
				) AS tongtg_canxuly,
				CASE
						WHEN r.Type = 1  THEN 'Chỉ thị'
						WHEN r.Type = 2  THEN 'Nghị quyết'
						WHEN r.Type = 3  THEN 'Công văn'
						WHEN r.Type = 4  THEN 'Kết luận'
						WHEN r.Type = 5  THEN 'Thông báo'
						WHEN r.Type = 6  THEN 'Đề nghị'
						WHEN r.Type = 7  THEN 'Quyết định'
						WHEN r.Type = 8  THEN 'Báo cáo'
						WHEN r.Type = 9  THEN 'Quy định'
						WHEN r.Type = 10 THEN 'Hợp đồng'
						WHEN r.Type = 11 THEN 'Đăng ký'
						WHEN r.Type = 12 THEN 'Biên bản'
						WHEN r.Type = 13 THEN 'Quy trình'
						WHEN r.Type = 14 THEN 'Hướng dẫn'
						WHEN r.Type = 15 THEN 'Kiến nghị'
						WHEN r.Type = 16 THEN 'Thanh tra'
						WHEN r.Type = 17 THEN 'Tờ trình'
						WHEN r.Type = 18 THEN 'Giấy phép'
						WHEN r.Type = 19 THEN 'Giấy mời'
						WHEN r.Type = 20 THEN 'Danh sách'
						WHEN r.Type = 21 THEN 'Kế hoạch'
						WHEN r.Type = 22 THEN 'Chương trình'
						WHEN r.Type = 23 THEN 'Giấy uỷ quyền'
						WHEN r.Type = 24 THEN 'Đề án'
						WHEN r.Type = 25 THEN 'Thông tư'
						WHEN r.Type = 26 THEN 'Quy chế'
						ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
				END AS Kieu,
				CASE
            WHEN t.Priority = 3 THEN 'Hỏa tốc'
            WHEN t.Priority = 2 THEN 'Thượng khẩn'
						WHEN t.Priority = 1 THEN 'Khẩn'
            ELSE 'Thường'
        END AS UuTien

    FROM ( SELECT * FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task WHERE `Status` <> 5 AND DeletedDate IS NULL ) t
    LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d 
           ON d.DepartmentIdExt = t.TargetDepartment
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d1
				ON d1.DepartmentId = d.ParentId
		/* Cha */
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d2

		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_giao1

		/* Ông */

		/* Cụ */

		/* Ông */

INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_nhom_tiepnhan_new_rt (`monthkey`, `date`, `month`, `year`, `nhomvb_ma`, `nhomvb`, `ma_nv_cha`, `Code`, `idnv`, `tennv_viettat`, `Ma`, `TenNhiemVu`, `SanPhamChuYeu`, `ThoiHanHoanThanh`, `NgayHoanThanh`, `TinhTrang`, `TienDoHoanThanh`, `songayquahan`, `tongtg_canxuly`, `tongtg_daxuly`, `don_vi_cap_01`, `loaicapcha`, `loaicap`, `don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao`, `loaicapcha_dvgiao`, `iddv_dvgiao`, `donvi_dvgiao`, `tenviettat_dvgiao`, `NguoiGiaoNhiemVu`, `donvi_dvthuchien`, `DonViPhoiHop`, `iddv_dvchutri`, `DonViChuTri`, `VanBanGiaoNhiemVu`, `NgayVanBan`, `LinhVuc`, `Kieu`, `UuTien`, `KetQuaGhiChu`, `NhomPhamViNhiemVu`, `TrangThai`, `TrangThaiVietTat`, `TrangThaiVietTat2`, `TenNhiemVu_Mobile`, `syncdate`)
SELECT
    main.monthkey,
    main.`date`,
    main.monthkey,
    main.`year`,
    main.nhomvb_ma,
    main.nhomvb,
    main.ma_nv_cha,
	main.`Code`,
	main.idnv,
	main.tennv_viettat,
    main.Ma,
    main.TenNhiemVu,
    main.SanPhamChuYeu,
    main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
    main.NgayHoanThanh,

    /* các cột còn lại */
    main.TinhTrang,
    main.TienDoHoanThanh,
    CASE
        /* chưa hoàn thành nhưng đã quá hạn */
        WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
             AND main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
             AND main.ThoiHanHoanThanh < CURDATE()
        THEN DATEDIFF(
                      CURDATE(),
                      main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
                         )

        /* đã hoàn thành nhưng quá hạn */
        WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
             AND main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
             AND main.NgayHoanThanh > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
        THEN DATEDIFF(
                      main.NgayHoanThanh,
                      main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
                         )

        ELSE NULL
    END AS songayquahan,
	main.tongtg_canxuly AS tongtg_canxuly,
	main.tongtg_daxuly AS tongtg_daxuly,
    -- main.songayquahan,
    main.don_vi_cap_01,
    main.loaicapcha,
	main.loaicap,
    main.don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao,
    main.loaicapcha_dvgiao,
    main.iddv_dvgiao,
    main.donvi_dvgiao,
    main.tenviettat_dvgiao,
    main.NguoiGiaoNhiemVu,
    main.donvi_dvthuchien,
    main.DonViPhoiHop,
	main.iddv_dvchutri,
	main.DonViChuTri,
    main.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
    main.NgayVanBan,
	main.LinhVuc,
    main.Kieu,
	main.UuTien,
    main.KetQuaGhiChu,
	main.NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
                /* TRẠNG THÁI SUY RA */
		CASE
				-- 1. Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
						AND main.NgayHoanThanh
								 <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn'

				-- 2. Đã hoàn thành quá hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
						AND main.NgayHoanThanh
								 > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn'

				-- 3. Chưa hoàn thành – trong hạn (còn > 1 ngày)
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						AND DATEDIFF(
										main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
										CURDATE()
								 ) > 5
						THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'

				-- 4. Chưa hoàn thành – sắp quá hạn (còn 1 ngày)
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						AND DATEDIFF(
										main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
										CURDATE()
								 ) <= 5
						THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn'

				-- 5. Chưa hoàn thành – quá hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						 AND CURDATE() > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
				-- NVU không hạn
				WHEN main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND main.TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành' THEN
					CONCAT(main.TinhTrang,' đúng hạn')
				WHEN main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND main.TinhTrang = 'Chưa hoàn thành' THEN
					CONCAT(main.TinhTrang,' trong hạn')
		END AS TrangThai,
		CASE
				-- 1. Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
						AND main.NgayHoanThanh
								 <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'HT đúng hạn'

				-- 2. Đã hoàn thành quá hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
						AND main.NgayHoanThanh
								 > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'HT quá hạn'

				-- 3. Chưa hoàn thành – trong hạn (còn > 1 ngày)
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						AND DATEDIFF(
										main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
										CURDATE()
								 ) > 5
						THEN 'CHT trong hạn'

				-- 4. Chưa hoàn thành – sắp quá hạn (còn 1 ngày)
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						AND DATEDIFF(
										main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
										CURDATE()
								 ) <= 5
						THEN 'CHT sắp quá hạn'

				-- 5. Chưa hoàn thành – quá hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'CHT quá hạn'
				
				WHEN main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND main.TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành' THEN
					'HT đúng hạn'
				WHEN main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND main.TinhTrang = 'Chưa hoàn thành' THEN
					'CHT trong hạn'
		END AS  TrangThaiVietTat,
		CASE
				-- 1. Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
						AND main.NgayHoanThanh
								 <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'HT đúng hạn'

				-- 2. Đã hoàn thành quá hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
						AND main.NgayHoanThanh
								 > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'HT quá hạn'

				-- 3. Chưa hoàn thành – trong hạn (còn > 1 ngày)
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						AND DATEDIFF(
										main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
										CURDATE()
								 ) > 5
						THEN 'Chưa HT trong hạn'

				-- 4. Chưa hoàn thành – sắp quá hạn (còn 1 ngày)
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						AND DATEDIFF(
										main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
										CURDATE()
								 ) <= 5
						THEN 'Chưa HT sắp quá hạn'

				-- 5. Chưa hoàn thành – quá hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'Chưa HT quá hạn'
				WHEN main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND main.TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành' THEN
					'HT đúng hạn'
				WHEN main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND main.TinhTrang = 'Chưa hoàn thành' THEN
					'Chưa HT trong hạn'
		END AS TrangThaiVietTat2,
                main.TenNhiemVu_Mobile,
    '${sync_ts}' AS syncdate

FROM (
    -- subquery của Tùng giữ nguyên
SELECT
        MAX(monthkey) AS monthkey,
				MAX(`date`) AS `date`,
        MAX(`month`) AS `month`,
				MAX(`year`) AS `year`,
        nhomvb_ma,
        MAX(nhomvb) AS nhomvb,
        MAX(ma_nv_cha) AS ma_nv_cha,
        -- SUBSTRING(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT LEFT(Ma,50) ORDER BY Ma SEPARATOR ', '),1,255) AS Ma,
				MIN(`Code`) AS `Code`,
				MIN(idnv) AS idnv,
				MIN(tennv_viettat) AS tennv_viettat,
				MIN(Ma) AS Ma,
        TenNhiemVu,
        MAX(SanPhamChuYeu) AS SanPhamChuYeu,
        MAX(ThoiHanHoanThanh) AS ThoiHanHoanThanh,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT( iddv) > 0 AND 
						COUNT( iddv)
                 = COUNT( CASE
                        WHEN TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành'
                        THEN 1
                   END)
            THEN MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành'
                THEN NgayHoanThanh
            END
						)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS NgayHoanThanh,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT( iddv) > 0 AND COUNT( iddv)
                 = COUNT( CASE
                        WHEN TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành'
                        THEN 1
                   END)
            THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'
            ELSE 'Chưa hoàn thành'
        END AS TinhTrang,
        CONCAT(ROUND(
               COUNT( CASE
                               WHEN TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành'
                               THEN iddv
               END)
               * 100.0
               / NULLIF(COUNT( iddv), 0),
               0
            ),'%') AS TienDoHoanThanh,
        MAX(songayquahan) AS songayquahan,
				MAX(tongtg_canxuly) AS tongtg_canxuly,
				MAX(tongtg_daxuly) AS tongtg_daxuly,
        don_vi_cap_01 AS don_vi_cap_01,
        loaicapcha AS loaicapcha,
        don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao AS don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao,
        loaicapcha_dvgiao AS loaicapcha_dvgiao,
        MAX(iddv_dvgiao) AS iddv_dvgiao,
        MAX(donvi_dvgiao) AS donvi_dvgiao,
        NULL AS tenviettat_dvgiao, -- MAX(tenviettat_dvgiao) AS tenviettat_dvgiao,
        SUBSTRING(GROUP_CONCAT(
            DISTINCT NguoiGiaoNhiemVu
            ORDER BY NguoiGiaoNhiemVu
            SEPARATOR '; '
        ),1,255) AS NguoiGiaoNhiemVu,
				loaicap,
        GROUP_CONCAT(
            DISTINCT donvi
            ORDER BY donvi
            SEPARATOR '; '
        ) AS donvi_dvthuchien,
        NULL AS DonViPhoiHop,
				MAX(iddv_dvchutri) AS iddv_dvchutri,
				MAX(DonViChuTri ) AS DonViChuTri,
        MAX(VanBanGiaoNhiemVu) AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
        MAX(NgayVanBan) AS NgayVanBan,
				IFNULL(MAX(LinhVuc),'Chưa xác định') AS LinhVuc,
        MAX(Kieu) AS Kieu,
				CASE MIN(
						CASE UuTien
								WHEN 'Hỏa tốc'      THEN 1
								WHEN 'Thượng khẩn'  THEN 2

/* [RT 12/11 full] ghi *_new_rt; TRUNCATE+INSERT → staging + RENAME swap */
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_giaonv_new_rt__stg LIKE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_giaonv_new_rt;
TRUNCATE TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_giaonv_new_rt__stg;
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_giaonv_new_rt__stg 
SELECT
main.monthkey AS monthkey,
main.loaicapcha AS loaicapcha,
main.loaicap AS loaicap,
main.iddv AS iddv,
main.donvi AS donvi,
main.tenviettat AS tenviettat,
main.loaicapcha_dvthuchien AS loaicapcha_dvthuchien,
main.loaicap_dvthuchien AS loaicap_dvthuchien,
main.iddv_dvthuchien AS iddv_dvthuchien,
main.donvi_dvthuchien AS donvi_dvthuchien,
main.tenviettat_dvthuchien AS tenviettat_dvthuchien,
main.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
main.LinhVuc AS LinhVuc,
main.Kieu AS Kieu,
main.tongso AS tongso,
main.daht AS daht,
main.daht_dh AS daht_dh,
main.daht_qh AS daht_qh,
main.daht_kh AS daht_kh,
main.dangth AS dangth,
main.dangth_th AS dangth_th,
main.dangth_qh AS dangth_qh,
main.dangth_sqh AS dangth_sqh,
main.dangth_kh AS dangth_kh,
main.nhomvb_ma AS nhomvb_ma,
main.nhomvb AS nhomvb,
main.syncdate AS syncdate

FROM (
SELECT 
    DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate,t.ExpireDate,t.CreatedDate), '%Y%m') + 0 AS monthkey,
		CASE
				WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%'  THEN 'Thành ủy Hà Nội'
				WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.1775%' THEN 'HĐND Thành phố'
				WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.1790%' THEN 'Ủy ban MTTQ Việt Nam thành phố Hà Nội'
				WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.698%'  THEN 'UBND Thành phố'
				ELSE 'Khác'
		END AS loaicapcha,
		NULL AS loaicap,
    dv_giao.DepartmentId AS iddv,
    IFNULL(dv_giao.DepartmentName ,'Chưa xác định') AS donvi,
    
		IFNULL(dv_giao.DepartmentShortName ,'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat,
		
		CASE
				WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.695%'  THEN 'Thành ủy Hà Nội'
				WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.1775%' THEN 'HĐND Thành phố'
				WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.1790%' THEN 'Ủy ban MTTQ Việt Nam thành phố Hà Nội'
				WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'  THEN 'UBND Thành phố'
				ELSE 'Khác'
		END AS loaicapcha_dvthuchien,
		NULL AS loaicap_dvthuchien,
    d.DepartmentId AS iddv_dvthuchien,
    IFNULL(d.DepartmentName ,'Chưa xác định') AS donvi_dvthuchien,
    
		IFNULL(d.DepartmentShortName ,'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat_dvthuchien,
		CASE
        WHEN t.DocCode LIKE "Số %" THEN REPLACE(t.DocCode,"Số ","")
				WHEN t.DocCode IS NOT NULL AND t.DocCode <> "" AND t.DocCode <> " " THEN t.DocCode
        ELSE 'Không xác định'
    END AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		s.SectorName AS LinhVuc,
		CASE
        WHEN r.Type = 1 THEN 'Chỉ thị'
        WHEN r.Type = 2 THEN 'Nghị quyết'
				WHEN r.Type = 3 THEN 'Công văn'
				WHEN r.Type = 4 THEN 'Kết luận'
				WHEN r.Type = 5 THEN 'Thông báo'
        ELSE 'Không xác định'
    END AS Kieu,

    /* Tổng số */
    COUNT(*) AS tongso,

    /* Nhóm đã hoàn thành (Status = 4) */
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)  <= t.ExpireDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_dh,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)  > t.ExpireDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_qh,
		NULL as daht_kh,

    /* Nhóm đang thực hiện (Status in -1,0,1,2,3) */
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND t.ExpireDate >= NOW() AND DATEDIFF(t.ExpireDate, NOW()) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_th,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND t.ExpireDate < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_qh,
		SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND t.ExpireDate >= NOW() AND DATEDIFF(t.ExpireDate, NOW()) <= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_sqh,
		NULL AS dangth_kh,
		
		COALESCE(rg4.ResolutionGroupId,rg3.ResolutionGroupId,rg2.ResolutionGroupId,rg1.ResolutionGroupId,rg.ResolutionGroupId) AS nhomvb_ma,
		COALESCE(rg4.Name,rg3.Name,rg2.Name,rg1.Name,rg.Name)  AS nhomvb,
		NOW() AS syncdate

FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task t
	LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d ON d.DepartmentIdExt = t.TargetDepartment
	LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_giao ON dv_giao.DepartmentIdExt = t.AssignDepartment
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution r ON t.ResolutionId = r.ResolutionId
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_sector s ON s.SectorId = r.SectorId
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg ON r.ResolutionGroupId = rg.ResolutionGroupId -- mức 1: cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg1 ON rg1.ResolutionGroupId = rg.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg1.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 2: cha của cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg2 ON rg2.ResolutionGroupId = rg1.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg2.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 3: cha của cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg3 ON rg3.ResolutionGroupId = rg2.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg3.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 4: cha của cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg4 ON rg4.ResolutionGroupId = rg3.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg4.IsRoot = 0
WHERE
    t.Status <> 5
    AND t.DeletedDate IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate,t.ExpireDate,t.CreatedDate), '%Y%m'),
		t.AssignDepartment,
    t.TargetDepartment,
		t.DocCode
		) main
ORDER BY 
    monthkey,
    iddv;
/* đổi chỗ nguyên tử, chờ khóa tối đa 10s */
SET SESSION lock_wait_timeout = 10;
RENAME TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_giaonv_new_rt TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_giaonv_new_rt__old, datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_giaonv_new_rt__stg TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_giaonv_new_rt, datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_giaonv_new_rt__old TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_giaonv_new_rt__stg;
SET SESSION lock_wait_timeout = 31536000;

						WHEN  d.Level = 3 THEN d.DepartmentName

						WHEN d2.Level = 3 THEN d2.DepartmentName
						WHEN d3.Level = 3 THEN d3.DepartmentName
						WHEN d4.Level = 3 THEN d4.DepartmentName
						ELSE NULL
				END AS loaicap_dvthuchien,
				d.DepartmentId AS iddv_dvthuchien,
				IFNULL(d.DepartmentName ,'Chưa xác định') AS donvi_dvthuchien,
				IFNULL(d.DepartmentShortName ,'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat_dvthuchien,
				d.ParentId AS iddv_captren_dvthuchien,
				IFNULL(u_giao.canbo_hoten ,'Chưa xác định') AS NguoiGiaoNhiemVu,
				CAST(
        CASE
						WHEN t.AssignDepartment IS NULL OR t.AssignDepartment = 'Chưa xác định'
								THEN 'Chưa xác định'
						WHEN  dv_giao.Level = 1 THEN dv_giao.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao1.Level = 1 THEN dv_giao1.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao2.Level = 1 THEN dv_giao2.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao3.Level = 1 THEN dv_giao3.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao4.Level = 1 THEN dv_giao4.DepartmentName
						ELSE NULL
				END AS CHAR(255)) AS don_vi_cap_01,
				CAST(
        CASE
						WHEN t.AssignDepartment IS NULL OR t.AssignDepartment = 'Chưa xác định'
								THEN 'Chưa xác định'
						WHEN  dv_giao.Level = 2 THEN dv_giao.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao1.Level = 2 THEN dv_giao1.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao2.Level = 2 THEN dv_giao2.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao3.Level = 2 THEN dv_giao3.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao4.Level = 2 THEN dv_giao4.DepartmentName
						ELSE NULL
				END AS CHAR(255)) AS loaicapcha,
				CAST(
				CASE
						WHEN t.AssignDepartment IS NULL OR t.AssignDepartment = 'Chưa xác định'
								THEN 'Chưa xác định'
						WHEN  dv_giao.Level = 3 THEN dv_giao.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao1.Level = 3 THEN dv_giao1.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao2.Level = 3 THEN dv_giao2.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao3.Level = 3 THEN dv_giao3.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao4.Level = 3 THEN dv_giao4.DepartmentName
						ELSE NULL
				END AS CHAR(255)) AS loaicap,
				dv_giao.DepartmentId AS iddv,
				IFNULL(dv_giao.DepartmentName ,'Chưa xác định') AS donvi,
				IFNULL(dv_giao.DepartmentShortName ,'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat,
				dv_giao.ParentId AS iddv_captren,
				IFNULL(u_thuchien.canbo_hoten ,'Chưa xác định') AS NguoiThucHien,
        NULL AS DonViPhoiHop,
				NULL AS iddv_dvchutri,
				NULL AS DonViChuTri,
				/* Bên tạo nhiệm vụ */
				IFNULL(u_taonv.don_vi_cap_01 ,'Chưa xác định') AS don_vi_cap_01_dvtaonv,
				IFNULL(u_taonv.loaicapcha ,'Chưa xác định') AS loaicapcha_dvtaonv,
				IFNULL(u_taonv.loaicap ,'Chưa xác định') AS loaicap_dvtaonv,
				u_taonv.iddv AS iddv_dvtaonv,
				IFNULL(u_taonv.donvi ,'Chưa xác định') AS donvi_dvtaonv,
				IFNULL(u_taonv.tenviettat ,'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat_dvtaonv,
				u_taonv.iddv_captren AS iddv_captren_dvtaonv,
				t.CreateUser AS NguoiTaoNhiemVuID,
				IFNULL(u_taonv.canbo_hoten ,'Chưa xác định') AS NguoiTaoNhiemVu,

        /* 12 - Văn bản giao */
        CASE
            WHEN t.DocCode LIKE "Số %" THEN REPLACE(t.DocCode,"Số ","")
						WHEN t.DocCode IS NOT NULL AND t.DocCode <> "" AND t.DocCode <> " " THEN t.DocCode
            ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
        END AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
				r.StartDate AS NgayVanBan,
				s.SectorName AS LinhVuc,
        /* 13 - Ghi chú */
        NULL AS KetQuaGhiChu,
				rp.ReportId AS ReportId,
				rp.Content AS NoiDungBaoCao,
				rp.CreatedDate AS ThoiDiemBaoCao,

        /* 14 - Trạng thái chi tiết */
        CASE
						WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) AND DATE( COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) )  <= DATE(t.ExpireDate)
								THEN 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn'
						WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) AND DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate))  > DATE(t.ExpireDate)
								THEN 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn'
						WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= DATE(NOW()) AND DATEDIFF(t.ExpireDate, NOW()) > 5
								THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'
						WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < DATE(NOW())
								THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
						WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= DATE(NOW()) AND DATEDIFF(t.ExpireDate, NOW()) <= 5 
								THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn'
						ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
				END AS TrangThai,
				CASE
						WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) THEN
								DATEDIFF(
										COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate),
										t.CreatedDate
								)
						ELSE NULL
				END AS tongtg_daxuly,
				DATEDIFF(
						t.ExpireDate,
						t.CreatedDate
				) AS tongtg_canxuly,
				CASE
						WHEN r.Type = 1  THEN 'Chỉ thị'
						WHEN r.Type = 2  THEN 'Nghị quyết'
						WHEN r.Type = 3  THEN 'Công văn'
						WHEN r.Type = 4  THEN 'Kết luận'
						WHEN r.Type = 5  THEN 'Thông báo'
						WHEN r.Type = 6  THEN 'Đề nghị'
						WHEN r.Type = 7  THEN 'Quyết định'
						WHEN r.Type = 8  THEN 'Báo cáo'
						WHEN r.Type = 9  THEN 'Quy định'
						WHEN r.Type = 10 THEN 'Hợp đồng'
						WHEN r.Type = 11 THEN 'Đăng ký'
						WHEN r.Type = 12 THEN 'Biên bản'
						WHEN r.Type = 13 THEN 'Quy trình'
						WHEN r.Type = 14 THEN 'Hướng dẫn'
						WHEN r.Type = 15 THEN 'Kiến nghị'
						WHEN r.Type = 16 THEN 'Thanh tra'
						WHEN r.Type = 17 THEN 'Tờ trình'
						WHEN r.Type = 18 THEN 'Giấy phép'
						WHEN r.Type = 19 THEN 'Giấy mời'
						WHEN r.Type = 20 THEN 'Danh sách'
						WHEN r.Type = 21 THEN 'Kế hoạch'
						WHEN r.Type = 22 THEN 'Chương trình'
						WHEN r.Type = 23 THEN 'Giấy uỷ quyền'
						WHEN r.Type = 24 THEN 'Đề án'
						WHEN r.Type = 25 THEN 'Thông tư'
						WHEN r.Type = 26 THEN 'Quy chế'
						ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
				END AS Kieu,
				CASE
            WHEN t.Priority = 3 THEN 'Hỏa tốc'
            WHEN t.Priority = 2 THEN 'Thượng khẩn'
						WHEN t.Priority = 1 THEN 'Khẩn'
            ELSE 'Thường'
        END AS UuTien

    FROM ( SELECT * FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task WHERE `Status` <> 5 AND DeletedDate IS NULL ) t
    LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d 
           ON d.DepartmentIdExt = t.TargetDepartment
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d1
				ON d1.DepartmentId = d.ParentId
		/* Cha */
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d2
				ON d2.DepartmentId = d1.ParentId
		/* Ông */
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d3

		/* Cụ */

		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_giao

		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_giao1
    ON dv_giao1.DepartmentId = dv_giao.ParentId
		/* Cha */
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_giao2
				ON dv_giao2.DepartmentId = dv_giao1.ParentId
		/* Ông */
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_giao3

		/* Cụ */

		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_taonv1

		/* Ông */

		/* Cụ */

		/* Người giao nhiệm vụ */

 		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.dm_user u_thuchien

 		/* Người tạo nhiệm vụ */
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.dm_user u_taonv

    LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution r

		LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_sector s

    LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg

		LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg1 ON rg1.ResolutionGroupId = rg.ParentGroupId

		LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg2 ON rg2.ResolutionGroupId = rg1.ParentGroupId

		LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg3 ON rg3.ResolutionGroupId = rg2.ParentGroupId

		LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg4 ON rg4.ResolutionGroupId = rg3.ParentGroupId

    LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_nhiem_vu_cho_duyet_copy nvcd

			          )

/* [RT 12/11 v4] Giao: logic như luồng cũ (đơn lẻ/chuỗi lấy đơn vị thực hiện); chỉ ghi dòng đổi; giữ syncdate */
UPDATE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_giaonv_new_rt g
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_giaonv_new_rt g_cha ON g.ma_nv_cha = g_cha.Ma
SET g.iddv_dvchutri = CASE WHEN g.NhomCauTrucNhiemVu = 'Nhiệm vụ đơn lẻ' THEN g.iddv_dvthuchien WHEN g.NhomCauTrucNhiemVu = 'Nhiệm vụ theo chuỗi' THEN COALESCE(g_cha.iddv_dvthuchien, g.iddv_dvthuchien) ELSE g.iddv END,
    g.DonViChuTri = CASE WHEN g.NhomCauTrucNhiemVu = 'Nhiệm vụ đơn lẻ' THEN g.donvi_dvthuchien WHEN g.NhomCauTrucNhiemVu = 'Nhiệm vụ theo chuỗi' THEN COALESCE(g_cha.donvi_dvthuchien, g.donvi_dvthuchien) ELSE g.donvi END,
    g.syncdate = g.syncdate
WHERE NOT (g.iddv_dvchutri <=> CASE WHEN g.NhomCauTrucNhiemVu = 'Nhiệm vụ đơn lẻ' THEN g.iddv_dvthuchien WHEN g.NhomCauTrucNhiemVu = 'Nhiệm vụ theo chuỗi' THEN COALESCE(g_cha.iddv_dvthuchien, g.iddv_dvthuchien) ELSE g.iddv END) OR NOT (g.DonViChuTri <=> CASE WHEN g.NhomCauTrucNhiemVu = 'Nhiệm vụ đơn lẻ' THEN g.donvi_dvthuchien WHEN g.NhomCauTrucNhiemVu = 'Nhiệm vụ theo chuỗi' THEN COALESCE(g_cha.donvi_dvthuchien, g.donvi_dvthuchien) ELSE g.donvi END);
